svg.title: OpenCode Console breach disclosure boundary
svg.desc: Editorial illustration: a hosted Console vault with a cracked key slot where provider keys may have been exposed, separated by an air gap from a local-app laptop that a co-founder said was not affected. The 1.4 percent figure is attributed to OpenCode; key use, attacker identity and a training link remain unverified in public evidence.
